1.explanation:
• Dropdown/__snapshots__ – shows the rendered markup and ID patterns currently produced by the component under test.  
• ListBox/README.md – details the ARIA roles and structure required for a listbox, including valid child roles (option).  
• Select/ – the main Select (Dropdown) component implementation, where aria-owns/aria-controls and id generation occur.  
• SelectItem/ & SelectItemGroup/ – the individual option and grouping subcomponents, which supply role="option" elements and IDs; you’ll need to inspect how they hook into the listbox.  
• ListItem/ – utility component used for list items in Carbon; may show default ID and role behavior that interacts with the dropdown’s listbox.
